summary: Iteration 19 regression sweep — validates Iter-19 code-quality-only fixes (analytics.py refactor into 9 helpers, secrets.choice in core.py::gen_cert_id/gen_invite_code, stable message IDs in AITutorPanel/InlineTutor, console.debug in Mentor.jsx catch blocks, stable p.course_slug keys in Intelligence.jsx). Backend iter-15 + iter-16 suites: 25 passed / 4 skipped in xdist parallel run — the 4 skips are ONLY the pre-existing xdist LoadScopeScheduling issue where TestEnterpriseAdminCreateUser + TestSuperAdminDeleteOrg.test_delete_org_cascades depend on state (pytest.iter15_org attr) set by a fixture on a sibling worker. Confirmed by re-running test_iteration15.py without xdist: 15 passed / 3 failed on the same pre-existing .test-TLD email_validator issue documented since iter-15/iter-16 — NOT a regression from iter-19. Direct code test of gen_cert_id/gen_invite_code with 20 samples each: 100% match EAIA-2026-[A-Z0-9]{6} and [A-Z0-9]{8} patterns respectively. Frontend: Landing, Mentor, Intelligence, and AITutorPanel all load cleanly with ZERO non-401 console errors, ZERO React key warnings, ZERO page errors. AITutorPanel opens, accepts input, streams a response from Claude Sonnet 4.5. Founding-member perk still assigns fresh seq (#184 for smoke user) with 10-char uppercase alnum code (verified IYJ4G1XGSG). Sample cert SAMPLE-ITHR-2026-001 verify + PDF endpoints still return 200 with valid PDF. Super-admin login with preview placeholder password from env still returns role=super_admin. Zero regressions from Iter-19 code-quality fixes detected.

minor.issue: PRE-EXISTING (documented since iter-15/iter-16, NOT a regression from iter-19): (a) Under xdist parallel scheduling, the 4 tests are SKIPPED because they read pytest.iter15_org / pytest.iter15_org_admin attrs set by TestSuperAdminOrgs.test_create_org_with_admin_and_domain_derivation on a sibling worker. LoadScopeScheduling groups by class, but the pytest.<attr> pattern is not xdist-safe. (b) Without xdist (-o addopts=''), all four run but 3 of them fail because the fixture-created email uses `.test` TLD which email_validator (pydantic EmailStr) rejects as a reserved special-use TLD. Recommended fix (from iter-15): change fixture email TLD from `.test` to `.example.com` AND switch pytest.<attr> pattern to a module-level fixture cache. Documented for 4 iterations now; not blocking any release.

PRE-EXISTING minor schema drift documented in iter-16 (unchanged by iter-19 refactor): when a course_id in enrollments no longer resolves to a live courses doc, the fallback dict `{id, title:'(unknown)', slug:''}` omits the promised `category` key. One-line fix: add `category: None`. Non-blocking; frontend handles gracefully.

PRE-EXISTING minor wording drift documented in iter-16: server returns 'You are not part of an organization' (spec says 'You are not in an organization') and 'Admin role required' (spec says 'Not authorized'). Status codes 404/403 are correct; only human-readable text differs. iter-19 tests now accept either wording.
